Search by item level: "level 55" finds items that are level 55 now or will be once fully upgraded, so Cutthroat Boots at 10/15 turn up under both "level 10" and "level 15". It works in the game's language too ("Stufe 55", "Niveau 55" ...).
Found chests show as gold stars on the game's compass at the top of the screen, so you can see which way to go.
With The Worst Map Mod 1.3.54 or newer, found chests show as gold stars on the World Map and the minimap too.
Big bases: Find reads every chest of the base. Before, it stopped after the first 256 containers, so chests in a large depot were never found. Opening the search is faster on big bases too.
Fixed:
Clicking a line in the list could make your character attack: the click finds it now when you let go of the button.
A search that found nothing left the previous search's chests glowing, so they looked like results.
After Enter found nothing, the search box didn't take your typing until you pressed Enter a few more times.
Reported bugs fixed:
Chests in very large bases, such as a Shroud Depot, weren't found (reported by VerySpecificDude).
